# Pies, fish dishes and sides
[color=#B7ABA0]THE WASTELAND TABLE / CHAPTER 05[/color]
## Mutfruit pie
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x pie dough + 3 x wild mutfruit + 1 x pie tin.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Baklava
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x pie dough + 1 x wild pinyon nuts + 1 x pie tin.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Blackberry pie
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x pie dough + 3 x wild blackberries + 1 x pie tin.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Meat pie
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x pie dough + 3 x raw irradiated meat + 1 x pie tin.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Cuban carp
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x dough + 2 x cheese wedge + 1 x wild glowpepper + 2 x raw redfish or whitefish fillet.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Sashimi
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 2 x raw redfish or whitefish fillet + 1u table salt.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Loaded baked potato
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild tato + 1 x cheese wedge.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Fries
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild tato + 5u table salt.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Cheesy fries
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild tato + 1 x cheese wedge + 5u table salt.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Carrot fries
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild carrot + 5u table salt.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Food snack popcorn
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild maize.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 20 seconds.
## Fish pie (whitefish)
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild razorgrain + 1 x whitefish steak + 1 x wild onion + 1 x wild tato.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Fish pie (redfish)
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild razorgrain + 1 x redfish steak + 1 x wild onion + 1 x wild tato.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
